ground_truth: Gordon et al. 2020 (PMID 32353859), IntAct/IMEx IM-27814: 26 baits, 332 HC interactions, 332 unique preys, 66 druggable proteins / 69 compounds — all four canonical numbers verified.
citation_integrity: All PMIDs/DOIs in the evidence packs were verified by the producing sub-agents against NCBI E-utilities + CrossRef; a sample of 9 key identifiers was independently re-verified in the parent session — all 9 resolved to the exact claimed papers. Sub-agents discarded several memory-recalled identifiers that failed verification (incl. one retracted paper).

gordon2020_edges.csv.desc: Ground-truth bait→prey edge list (332 rows), IntAct-sourced, per-Nsp baits recovered.

gordon2020_counts.json.desc: Confirmed counts + canonical-number reconciliation + discrepancy notes.

demo_protein_shortlist.md.desc: Demo proteins ranked by literature richness; Orf6 & Orf9b top the list.

edge_packs/orf6_nup98.json.desc: Evidence pack: Orf6–NUP98 + NUP98–RAE1 neighbor (5+3 verified papers).

edge_packs/orf9b_tom70.json.desc: Evidence pack: Orf9b–TOMM70 + TOMM70–HSP90 (5+3 verified papers).

edge_packs/n_g3bp1.json.desc: Evidence pack: N–G3BP1 + G3BP1–G3BP2 (5+3 verified papers).

worked_example_orf6.json.desc: Flagship held-out example: Orf6–RAE1 recovered via NUP98–RAE1; full cited chain + Orf9b backup.

crispr_gold_standard.csv.desc: 27-gene cross-screen consensus (≥2 of 7 screens); SCAP is the sole overlap with Gordon prey.

crispr_screens.json.desc: Per-screen provenance (7 screens, verified PMID/DOI, cell line).

cartograph_domain.json.desc: Domain priors: 12 prey complexes, family interaction priors, 5 AP-MS FP patterns; 16 verified sources.

caveats: CRISPR consensus is built from top hits reported in abstracts/main text, not full genome-wide hit tables — treat the 27-gene set as a high-confidence core, not exhaustive. The near-zero overlap with AP-MS prey (only SCAP) is expected: functional-dependency screens and physical-binding AP-MS capture orthogonal biology. Present Option B as corroboration, not proof (Option A = frozen held-out edges remains the guaranteed number).
Druggability (66/69) is a curated pharmacology annotation from the Gordon supplement, not part of the 332-edge PPI record.
